app.name: Ballance
app.long_description:
A source port of the Ballance runtime (Ballanced) to the Nintendo Wii.
Copy base.cmo, Database.tdb and the 3D Entities, Sounds, Textures and Text folders from your own Ballance installation into this folder.
Controls: hold the Wii Remote sideways (D-Pad moves the ball, 1 rotates the camera, 2 lifts the camera, + pauses), or use a Nunchuk, Classic Controller or GameCube controller. Point at the screen and press A in menus. An on-screen keyboard appears when the game asks for a name. HOME opens the HOME menu.
